# Zenvylo

> A lead-finding tool for freelancers and small agencies who sell digital
> services to local businesses. It finds real businesses near a chosen
> location, fetches and measures each one's website, and ranks them by
> verified, checkable problems — not by guesswork.

## What makes it different

Most lead tools return a list of names and a plausible-sounding score. Zenvylo
fetches every prospect's website and records what is actually there: whether
HTTPS is present, whether the page is mobile-ready, how long it took to
respond, whether it has a page title and search description, tap-to-call,
a contact form, online booking, analytics, structured data, and how stale the
content is.

Every issue shown to the user quotes the measurement behind it, so a freelancer
can put it in a cold email and the business owner can verify it. Nothing is
inferred. The tool refuses to state revenue estimates, traffic figures or
competitor claims it has not measured.

It also compares a prospect against its nearest same-category neighbours —
measured the same way — so the pitch can be "five of the six nearest cafés have
online booking and you don't" rather than a generic complaint.

## Who it's for

- Freelance web designers, SEO consultants, social media managers
- Small agencies doing local outreach
- Anyone selling a digital service to bricks-and-mortar businesses

## How it works

1. Pick what you sell (twelve presets, or type your own service).
2. Pick a country and optionally a city.
3. Zenvylo pulls real businesses from OpenStreetMap for that area.
4. It fetches and measures each business's website.
5. Findings and a 0–100 score are computed in code from those measurements,
   weighted for the service being sold.
6. Claude writes the outreach, citing only the verified findings.

You can also import an existing prospect list from CSV, which costs no scans
and runs the same measurement pipeline.

## Pricing

- Free — 3 scans/month, 5 leads per scan
- Starter, $9/mo — 20 scans/month
- Growth, $19/mo — 50 scans/month, all countries, choose 1–8 leads per scan
- Pro, $39/mo — 100 scans/month, AI outreach and proposals, 1–10 leads per scan
- Scale, $79/mo — 200 scans/month, 1–15 leads per scan
- Enterprise — contact support@zenvylo.com
